# spoke_static_target_binding (Resource)

Experimental project-owned reservation for one application and destination environment. Requires a project-only provider; the environment principal separately consumes it through spoke_static_target. Retirement cancels only through Platform's authoritative protocol. A live target or uncertain release keeps the parent application held. Target retirement releases the reservation, so coordinate catalog and environment states before recreation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use a project-only provider. Hand the reservation ID to the environment root.
resource "spoke_static_target_binding" "nightly" {
  management_key = "site-nightly-reservation"
  application_id = "123"
  environment_id = "nightly"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Exact application ID in this project; changing it requires replacement and a new management_key.
- `environment_id` (String) Destination environment identifier. Changing it requires replacement and a new management_key.
- `management_key` (String) Stable non-secret reservation recovery identity. Use a new key when changing a live reservation's application or destination.

### Read-Only

- `admission_revision` (String) Application revision captured immediately before original admission and retained with that request. Not an ongoing dependency; nullable after import.
- `id` (String) Canonical import identity: organization_id/project_id/binding_id.
- `operation_key` (String) Last retained mutation key or next creation slot selected by this plan.
- `owner_id` (String) Principal owning the retained reservation management namespace.
- `resource_id` (String) Exact reservation ID supplied to an environment target.
- `revision` (String) Observed reservation revision, including consumption/cancellation transitions.
- `state` (String) Observed reserved, consumed or cancelling state.
- `target_id` (String) Nullable consuming target ID. A missing/denied child read cannot release this reservation.
